name: S3 Huahin Hotel
detail: The room is a bit small, but very clean. The bed is wide and very soft, and the blankets and pillowcases are very clean. The swimming pool is on the third floor. The location is easy to find, right on the main road near convenience stores and markets. Overall, it's nice.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: RELO' The Urban Escape
detail: The rooms are very nice. I booked 2 rooms with a sea view. The rooms are clean and fragrant, beautifully designed in a Balinese style. The breakfast is a bit lacking considering the price of nearly 4,000. The soundproofing of the rooms is average. It's right on the beach, with a private beach area. The swimming pool is beautiful, perfect for relaxation in a private atmosphere. The staff are attentive.
area: Hua Hin Beachfront,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: The Yana Villas Hua Hin
detail: The accommodation is conveniently located with a great spot next to Hua Hin beach at a reasonable price. The rooms are spacious and clean, and the staff provides good service. It is suitable for vacations with family or couples. The breakfast does not offer a wide variety of options, but it is sufficient for general dining.
area: Khao Takiab Beach Front,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Royal Pavilion Hua Hin
detail: Accommodating 6 people, 2 adults and 4 children Staying in a penthouse room The mattress is quite firm The bathroom is clean The kitchen is clean The staff provides good service The accommodation is near Chatuchai Market, within walking distance Breakfast is acceptable The area around the hotel is quite convenient, near banks and near coffee shops, easy to travel The Wi-Fi internet is smooth and fast
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Chalelarn Hotel
detail: Affordable hotel, clean, with good service staff, close to restaurants and the community. The rooftop pool has a great view, the water is clean, and the bedding is clean with a soft mattress. If there is an opportunity, I will stay again.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: City Beach Resort
detail: Convenient travel near Hua Hin beach, with a swimming pool and close to places to eat. You can walk to the night market. There is a late check-out service for an additional 500 baht, allowing you to stay until 6:00 PM. Very worth it!
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Maven Stylish Hotel Hua Hin
detail: The location is convenient for going to both the station and the night market, situated along a main road in the best spot. The front desk has staff available 24 hours a day, and they called a tuk-tuk for me when I went out. The staff, both male and female, were all very friendly. I stayed for 10 nights this time. On the day before the last day, during breakfast, a cake with my name saying Thank you for 10 days was presented, and I was very touched by this wonderful hospitality. The breakfast varied with different dishes each day, so I never got bored over the 10 days. I brought my Fire TV Stick and watched videos in my room, but the Wi-Fi was weak during that time, so I rated it 4 stars. This is an outstanding hotel with no complaints.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Kiang Haad Beach Hua Hin Hotel
detail: The room was very clean, and it smelled great. I really liked the soap and shampoo in the shower; they had a wonderful lemongrass scent. The bathroom was just the right size, and the water flow was strong, making it a lot of fun to shower. The room had a beautiful view of the swimming pool and the lovely garden. It was close to Market Village, so if you didn't want to drive anywhere, you could have both lunch and dinner at the mall, which had reasonable prices. It was less than 50 meters to walk to a 7-Eleven nearby. There was also a delicious coffee shop downstairs in the hotel, or you could relax by the pool on the fourth floor. The staff provided very good service, the air conditioning was comfortable, and the television was clear. I really liked the towels; they were large and very soft. I truly enjoyed my stay at this accommodation.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: ibis Hua Hin
detail: A guest-friendly place with excellent service from staff, starting with the receptionist and security personnel in the parking lot. The amenities around the accommodation are good. The exterior may not look new, but the interior is well-maintained. The bed is comfortable, and the air conditioning is cool. Although the hairdryer in the room was broken, it was quickly addressed by the staff and housekeeping. I would like to commend and recommend this place. :)
area: Khao Takiab,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map

name: Chaba Chalet
detail: We stayed with a friend, just the two of us. The cost per night was very cheap. The room was quite nice, the air conditioning was so cold we could adjust it well. There was a bathtub with hot water, and the bed was very clean, not itchy, and soft. The housekeeping did a good job. The soap and shampoo provided were good to use. The room had a dressing table and a large mirror, which made it convenient for two women to do their makeup together. It’s close to the train station, the market, the beach, and a 7-11. We walked everywhere because it was very close and convenient, which we really liked about the location. It also saved on transportation costs. I recommend this place for anyone traveling by train. The only downside of this accommodation was that the bathroom door in our room couldn't lock and didn’t close properly, but it wasn’t too bad; it still closed okay. Everything else was great, very convenient, and we slept well.
area: Hua Hin City Center,Hua Hin / Cha-am - View on map
